visual_action: The video is a slideshow of two static images. The first is a photo of Mike Johnson looking down, with a text overlay. The second is a screenshot of a news article headline about Mike Johnson, which also features a photo of him being sworn in.

central_claim: House Speaker Mike Johnson holds extremist anti-LGBTQ+ views, exemplified by his past claim that homosexuality caused the fall of the Roman Empire.
intended_effect: To generate disapproval of Mike Johnson by portraying him as having extreme and prejudiced beliefs.
